fusions.name: Safety in Numbers
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble that deals 4 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Alarm Rush
fusions.desc: A rush of hooves and paws ahead of you deals 26 damage to everything in a cone 6 tiles long. Hitting anything makes every ally strike 15% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddled Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Grazing Lull
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
